gizmo.title: Zindikirani malo
gizmo.description: Ophunzira amapeza malo oyenera pa chithunzi podina, kukhudza kapena kusuntha chizindikiro cha kiyibodi. Mnzake wopatsidwa magiredi wa mapu a chithunzi.

configure.title: Zolemba zina
configure.description: Chimafotokoza chithunzi kwa anthu omwe sangathe kuchiwona. Sichiwonetsedwa ngati mutu.

configure.title: Mutu
configure.description: Mutu wachidule wowoneka wowonetsedwa pamwamba pa chithunzi.

configure.title: Funso
configure.description: Zomwe ophunzira afunsidwa kupeza mu chithunzi.

configure.title: Mayankho
configure.description: Yankho lililonse ndi chozungulira chotchulidwa dzina pa chithunzi. Malo ndi kukula ndi maperesenti a chithunzi, oyezedwa kuchokera ku ngodya yake yakumanzere pamwamba. Mukamasintha, yankho lililonse limazunguliridwa mzere pa chithunzi.

advanced.title: Kuyesa
advanced.description: Kangati wophunzira angayese. 0 imatanthauza mopanda malire.

advanced.title: Kuphonya kololedwa
advanced.description: Kuphonya kangati kumathetsa kuyesa. 0 imatanthauza mopanda malire, ndipo ophunzira amapeza batani la Malizani.

advanced.title: Yopindika
advanced.description: Onetsani funsoli ngati mzere womwe umatseguka ndi kutseka. Kutsegula limodzi kumatseka mafunso ena opindika omwe ali pafupi nalo.

advanced.title: Yambani mopindidwa
advanced.description: Ikakhala yopindika, yambani ngati mzere wotsekedwa womwe umawonetsa funso ndi momwe lilili kokha.

advanced.title: Mtundu wa kupereka magiredi
advanced.description: OER Schema: mtundu wa kupereka magiredi pa kuyesa uku (mwachitsanzo mapointi, chilembo, peresenti, kumaliza).

advanced.title: Cholinga cha maphunziro
advanced.description: OER Schema: cholinga cha maphunziro chogwirizana ndi kuyesa uku.

developer.title: Dzina la mayeso
developer.description: Dzina la mayeso lotumizidwa kuti ligwiritsidwe ntchito m'malo oyendetsedwa ndi xAPI pozindikiritsa chinthu ichi

developer.title: Maphunziro
